Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through an intersection in Baytown, Texas, and was making a left turn when the vehicle was
struck on the front driver side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding straight through the same intersection.
Dirver 1 reported lower back strain immediately after the impact, and the reported injury is consistent with the forces
expected in a collision of this type. The Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat, and both the responding
officers and the scene witnesses confirmed that the Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
Damage to Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with the described impact pattern. Several older scratches along
the rear quarter panel may predate this incident and were noted for reference only. No independent witnesses,
photographs, or other reports were located that document the collision itself beyond the sattements provided at the
scene. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle.
